title: Bounded flat subextensions over a prescribed small flat subsheaf
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Flatness means tensor-flatness [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. For a module sheaf $M$ set $|M|=|\coprod_{U\in\operatorname{Ob}\mathcal C}M(U)|$. There is an infinite cardinal $\mu$, depending only on the site and $R$, with the following property for every infinite cardinal $\kappa\geq\mu$ satisfying $\kappa^\mu=\kappa$. Given a short exact sequence $0\to A\xrightarrow{i}B\xrightarrow{q}C\to0$ in $\mathcal A$ with $A$ flat, and a flat subsheaf $C_0\subseteq C$ with $|C_0|\leq\kappa$, there is a subsheaf $B_0\subseteq q^{-1}(C_0)\subseteq B$ with $|B_0|\leq\kappa$ such that $q|_{B_0}:B_0\to C_0$ is an epimorphism and, writing $A_0=i^{-1}(B_0)$, both $A_0$ and $A/A_0$ are flat. In particular $0\to A_0\to B_0\to C_0\to0$ is short exact. All section sets and cardinals lie in one fixed universe containing the small site and $R$. Neither enough points nor sectionwise surjectivity of $q$ is assumed.
